PQR-1: The bidder shall be a manufacturer of mild steel/ carbon steel pipes. Scanned copy of an y one of the following documents valid on the original due date of opening and duly attested by N otary Public or Chartered Accountant shall be enclosed towards PQR-1: a. NSIC b. District Industri es Centre c. UDYAM Registration Certificate d. SSI Certificate e. BIS Certificate f. Any accredited I SO Certificate. PQR-2: The bidder should have supplied mild steel or carbon steel pipes/tubes for a total order v alue of Rs.4.5 Lakhs in a maximum of two Purchase Orders to any of GOVT/Quasi Govt./PSU/Publi c Limited companies during the last TEN years prior to the original scheduled date of tender open ing. Following documentary evidence shall be furnished along with the bid towards PQR-2: Copy o f Purchase Orders and corresponding Material Acceptance Report/ IRR / supply Completion Certifi cate, with drawing/ specification of material, to confirm that the materials supplied were mild ste el or carbon steel pipes/tubes. PQR-3: Authorized Dealers can also participate in the bid provided their Manufacturer satisfies th e PQR 1 and the bidder meets PQR 2 condition either in their name or in the name of their manuf acturer. Following documentary evidence shall be furnished along with the bid towards PQR-3: 1. Valid Authorization certificate from principal manufacturer with reference of GEM bid. 2. Docume ntary evidence for PQR-2, in the name of the bidder or manufacturer. 3. An Undertaking Letter fro m the Manufacturer to supply the pipes within the Enquiry Delivery Schedule if the Dealer emerg es as a successful bidder in the Tender. NOTE: 1. Previous supplier to NLCIL satisfying the above PQR 1,2 and 3 shall give reference of re levant Purchase Order Number and IRR No and they will be qualified based on their past perform ance with NLCIL. 2. Both manufacturer and authorized dealer shall participate in the bid. 3. In cas e of participation by both the manufacturer and authorized dealer for same item/ product, offer o f manufacturer only will be considered for evaluation
